files..tld/toolkit.yaml:
docs:
  must_read:
  - README.md
git:
  main_branch: main
  branch_pattern: <type>/<kebab-case>
verify:
  fast:
  - python3 -m unittest -q
  dod:
  - python3 -m unittest -q
stacks:
- python
roles:
  posture:
    security: critical
  disable:
  - website-maintainer
  required:
  - role: security-reviewer
    at:
    - implement_phase
    - implement_final
    blocking: true
  - role: test-architect
    at:
    - make_plan
    blocking: false
